metas.name: Kanaa
metas.description: Anbarasi, an innocent village girl, dreams of making a name for herself in the field of sports but faces numerous obstacles. Will she manage to tackle the hurdles and fulfil her dream?

metas.name: Ninaithen Vandhai
metas.description: Ezhil is devastated after his wife Indhumathi’s death. A simple village girl, Sudarvizhi, steps in to be his children's caretaker. But can Sudarvizhi fill the void in Ezhil and his children’s hearts?

metas.name: #Love
metas.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

metas.name: Resort
metas.description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

metas.name: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
metas.description: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

metas.name: Heart Beat
metas.description: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

metas.name: Brothers and Sisters
metas.description: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

metas.name: Udho Udho Shri Renuka Yellamma
metas.description: Renuka and Yellamma, reincarnations of goddess Parvathi, have come to earth for the betterment of humankind. Witness their divinity and mesmerising powers.

metas.name: Chinna Thambi
metas.description: Two people, who are poles apart, find love in each other. However, they face several problems because they belong to different cultures.

metas.name: The Court
metas.description: A young lawyer, brilliant with case details, struggles to find her place within the legal fraternity. Her two opponents: her celebrated father and her stammer.

metas.name: Suzhal - The Vortex
metas.description: A minor girl goes missing in a small town in Tamilnadu and an investigation follows. A sub inspector investigating a missing girl's case in a uncovers some shocking revelations and dirty truths those threaten to shake up the cultural societal fabric.

metas.name: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal
metas.description: The story revolves around a group of high school students and the struggles the high school students from that group face during their secondary school life such as jealousy, rivalry, misunderstandings, arguments and personal grudges.

metas.name: Nadu Center
metas.description: They fight, they fall, they rise... together!

metas.name: Vadhandhi
metas.description: Vivek, a diligent cop, takes charge of the investigation of the murder of a beautiful young girl, Velonie. The rumours about her that spring up post her death threatens to irrevocably damage Velonie's image, Vivek must wade through a web of half-truths and confusing leads to solve the case.

metas.name: Uppu Puli Kaaram
metas.description: A hotel owner and father of four faces a predicament with the arrival of his abandoned son. Will the family dynamics get spicier or sour?

metas.name: Marmadesam
metas.description: Marmadesam, meaning "Land of Mystery" in Tamil, is a television series directed by Naga. The series was telecast between 1997 and 2001 and was very successful.

metas.name: Paavam Ganesan
metas.description: Ganesan, who lets the world walk over him, gets burdened with the responsibility of his family. What does fate have in store for this paavam young man?

metas.name: Five Six Seven Eight
metas.description: Semba and Vikram, two teenagers belonging to different strata of society, come together to help a friend in need. They courageously try to overcome many obstacles in their path with just one thing filling their hearts and souls - dance.

metas.name: TamilRockerz
metas.description: Tamil Rockerz, an anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.

metas.name: Navarasa
metas.description: From amusement to awe, the nine human emotions of Indian aesthetic theory are explored in this anthology series.

metas.name: Inspector Rishi
metas.description: A sceptic one-eyed crime branch Inspector Rishi Nandhan assisted by his two trusted sub-inspectors Ayyanar and Chitra, investigates strange and mind-bending cases involving supernatural or paranormal phenomena. He stops at nothing in his efforts to find the truth behind unexplainable murders while also battling various challenges in his personal life.

metas.name: Chinna Papa Periya Papa
metas.description: Wealthy Chennai woman flaunts riches, constantly vying with daughter-in-law in humorous pranks and misadventures, their relationship akin to Tom and Jerry's.

metas.name: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
metas.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

metas.name: Warrant
metas.description: A bullied and vulnerable small‑town constable transforms into a brutal force while solving forgotten warrant cases, until a custodial death forces the law to judge the man he has become.

metas.name: Good Wife
metas.description: Lawyer-turned-homemaker Tharunika's 16 Years of marriage life and her peaceful world is shattered and is forced to return to the courtroom after her husband, becomes embroiled in a high–profile sex and political corruption scandal.

metas.name: Pettaikaali
metas.description: To marry the girl he loves, the hero tames a bull that belongs to her with deceptive tricks. His frivolous act rekindles the bygone animosity between the families that prompts several problems.

metas.name: Oru Kodai Murder Mystery
metas.description: Vyom, the school principal's a nerdy teenager son is disliked by most of his classmates, has only four friends, and a crush, Tara. When Tara goes missing and found dead, Vyom decides to solve the mystery behind her death.

metas.name: Aindham Vedham
metas.description: Anu travels to Varanasi for her mother’s last rites, where a priest asks her to deliver an ancient relic to a temple in Tamil Nadu. While she plans to disobey his command, fate has other plans.

metas.name: The Village
metas.description: In the desolate hinterlands of Tamil Nadu, a stranded urbanite enlists the help of three locals to find his missing family believed to have been abducted by nefarious beings of a cursed village. Meanwhile, a maniacal heir to a pharma empire sends a group of mercenaries to the same village to retrieve something long forgotten. Will they come out of this terror-stricken night alive?

metas.name: Thadayam
metas.description: In 1999, a string of brutal midnight murders terrifies tamil nadu's border villages but when a sharp new officer arrives, he uncovers a chilling pattern.

metas.name: Singappenne
metas.description: Born into a humble & rustic background troubled by familial & financial concerns, Anandhi takes it upon herself to leave home & fearlessly pursue a better life for her family. Watch her bravely face the odds of life with unwavering spirit.

metas.name: EXAM
metas.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: Set in the 1980s matriarchal society of a fictional city of Pernuru, South India, women reign supreme and power has a new name - Akka! Akka is the tale of gangster queens whose matriarchal rule is challenged when an outsider brings an unseen threat, spiralling the all-powerful sisterhood into a chaos storm of violence and survival.

metas.name: Mad Company
metas.description: AK,once a popular actor gets expelled from the industry for his attitude that is misunderstood by the insiders.  He starts up a venture that is committed to bridge the gap between ordinary folks and the relationships they miss in their lives.

metas.name: Triples
metas.description: Three friends set out to Goa to deal with a major problem that threatens to ruin their business, and lives. A loan shark, a politician who is on the lookout for his daughter, an ex-wife and a current girlfriend make their journey adventurous.

metas.name: Ramany Vs Ramany
metas.description: Swathi Family Entertainer presents here, the first ever Tamil comedy play in the "sitcom" format, directed by Naga of Marmadesam fame. The era of Min Bimbangal in Tamil Television (1990 - 2005) was a golden era of riveting, taut, intelligent, engaging and meaningful serials, all lush with life. The oeuvre of Min Bimbangal encompassed a broad range of genres, including sitcoms, soaps, homegrown thrillers and chat shows; every one of them being trend setters par excellence. The home being a Moral Instruction Class of his dominating mother, Mr. Ramany is a potential candidate for the couch. His dream was to flee to the US of A like a normal urban Indian, but his family had other plans; to shackle his ankle, as they say in Tamil, to Ms. Ramany. The influence of the wanna-be generations on one side and the overdose of Sai Baba bhajans on the other, she is equally, a candidate for the couch.

metas.name: Putham Pudhu Kaalai Vidiyaadhaa
metas.description: This is a Tamil anthology series comprising five episodes. All five tales hark back to themes of love, hope and togetherness in trying times

metas.name: Snakes & Ladders
metas.description: Four reckless kids, while trying to cover up an accident, find themselves caught in dangerous situations - chased by cops, dim-witted thugs and their own bad choices.

metas.name: MY3
metas.description: A rich entrepreneur struggling with an allergy to human touch finds a solution in a robot. But when it crashes before delivery, a 'real' replacement is sent.

metas.name: Lingam
metas.description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

metas.name: Emoji
metas.description: Aadhav and Deeksha, a vibrant young couple are about to be separated as passion pulls them apart. Can love win them back together?

metas.name: Madurai Paiyanum Chennai Ponnum
metas.description: Subash, a 27-year-old soulful Madurai native now thriving in Chennai, balancing life as a bookstore employee, budding lyricist, and IPS aspirant. His peaceful life takes an unexpected turn when Mira, an ambitious 25-year-old with dreams of opening a terrace cafe. This Clash of dreams evolves into a heartfelt journey. Subash and Mira transform the terrace into a vibrant place of good food and music.

metas.name: Police Police
metas.description: A cop hires a criminal to become a cop illegally. How long will they manage to get away with it?

metas.name: Seetha Raman
metas.description: Destiny forces Seetha to marry Ram, her sister's groom. But his stepmother refuses to accept Seetha as she does not meet her expectations. Seetha must now find a way to win over her in laws.

metas.name: Journey
metas.description: Five equally talented candidates. One vacancy. Having journeyed through trying times in their lives, each of them must prove why they deserve the job. Can they rely on their past to help build their future?

metas.name: Karoline Kamakshi
metas.description: A laidback CBI officer Kamakshi, hailing from an orthodox Brahmin family, is teamed up with a French agent Karoline to follow up on a mission to unearth Virgin Mary, an artefact stolen from Paris by a local gangster Furkin.

metas.name: As I'm Suffering From Kadhal
metas.description: The different problems that arise between couples before they tie the knot and after, the issues faced by couples who don’t believe in the concept of marriage and the complications in the life of a divorcee.

metas.name: My Perfectt Husband
metas.description: Saraswathi believes she is the only woman in her husband Bharathi's life. However, a marriage alliance for their son brings back a blast from the past.

metas.name: Fall
metas.description: An accident followed by memory loss has Divya trying to piece her life together. Will her near and dear ones support her quest for the truth?

metas.name: Live Telecast
metas.description: A TV crew goes to a haunted house, where a family lives, to create a new live show that captures ghost on camera, only to be trapped inside with no way of getting out.

metas.name: Kuttram Purindhavan
metas.description: In a small-town, when a girl goes missing, Retiree Baskaran takes extreme measures to protect his grandson, Esther is consumed by guilt, and powerless constable Gautham races to find the truth. Secrets surface, leading to an uneasy alliance between Baskaran and Gautham, to a final showdown, justice is served, but guilt leaves some with closure and others haunted.
